To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the RD-LDA-based feature extraction approach gives better results than PCA and MDF-based feature extraction approaches in the case of hand-based personal recognition.
the best results in the personal recognition based on hand images are obtained with the use of RD-LDA -based feature extraction approach.
the best results in terms of recognition accuracy are achieved when the RD-LDA is applied to the features extracted from the regions of the palmar hand surface.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a personal recognition system which is based on a new approach to the extraction of features from images of the palmar hand surface, and which is multimodal in nature.
the design and development of personal recognition system based on features extracted from the palmar surface (the back of the hand).

the following aspects: - the design of an experimental personal recognition systems based on the hand geometry, - the development and comparison of three feature extraction approaches (PCA, MDF, and RD-LDA) in this system, and - the testing of the system on 184 people (920 identification tests, 64170 verification test).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RD-LDA approach is the best choice for feature extraction from hand images in a personal recognition system.
the RD-LDA based feature extraction approach is the most suitable approach for the tested system.
the RD-LDA approach outperforms the other two approaches.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed system is a good alternative to the systems based on face, fingerprint or iris recognition.
the proposed RD-LDA-based feature extraction approach is the best one in terms of both identification and verification performance.
the RD-LDA-based feature extraction approach is superior to both the PCA- and the MDF-based approaches in hand-based personal recognition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed RD-LDA -based approach can be successfully applied for hand-based biometric recognition.
the RD-LDA approach can be successfully applied for personal recognition based on hand images.
RD-LDA -based feature extraction is more effective in the hand-based personal recognition system than PCA- and MDF-based approaches.
